name: AI Automation Solutions
tagline: AI chatbots, workflow automation, and AI-powered content — so your business runs without you doing the repetitive work.

hero.headline: Save Hours Every Week with AI Automation That Actually Works
hero.subhead: From automated workflows to custom AI assistants and AI-produced content — built around your real business processes.

description: Repetitive tasks are the biggest time drain in any business. I build AI-powered workflows and assistants that replace manual data entry, follow-ups, reporting, and customer questions — plus AI-assisted content production so you're never starting from a blank page. Every system is trained on your business context, not a generic template.
problems: You're spending hours a week on repetitive tasks like data entry, follow-ups, or reporting
Customers ask the same questions over and over and there's no one to answer after hours
You want an AI assistant but don't know how to make it actually know your business
Creating consistent social media and blog content is eating your week
deliverables: Up to 3 live automation workflows connecting the tools you already use
AI chatbot or assistant deployed on your website, Facebook, or WhatsApp
Knowledge base built from your business info, FAQs, and policies
Custom prompt library and system instructions for consistent AI output
A month of AI-assisted content: social posts, blog outlines, and email newsletters
features: Integration with Gmail, Google Sheets, WhatsApp, Facebook, and most tools with an API
Custom AI agents that qualify leads or process documents
Fallback handling so the AI escalates to a human when it doesn't know the answer
AI-assisted copywriting refined to match your brand voice
Business process audits to find the highest-impact automations first

process.detail: Identify which manual tasks are costing you the most time.
Map the automation or AI assistant to your actual tools and workflows.
Build the workflows or AI system and train it on your business knowledge.
Run real-world scenarios to catch edge cases before launch.
Deploy, train your team, and provide 30 days of post-launch support.

faqs.question: What kinds of tasks can be automated?
faqs.answer: Common examples: follow-up messages to leads, weekly reports from Google Sheets, auto-posting to social media, processing inquiry forms, and scheduling reminders.

faqs.question: What's the difference between a chatbot and an AI system?
faqs.answer: A chatbot follows fixed scripts. An AI system understands natural language, handles unexpected questions, and gives answers based on your specific business knowledge.

faqs.question: Will the AI-written content sound robotic?
faqs.answer: No — AI drafts and structures the content, then it's refined to match your brand voice before delivery.

faqs.question: What happens when the AI doesn't know the answer?
faqs.answer: Fallback responses gracefully escalate to a human or collect the customer's contact info for follow-up.
